evals.prompt: Audit a user registration endpoint against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities (SQL injection, weak password hashing, missing rate limits).
evals.expected_output: A security audit report identifying vulnerabilities and providing hardened remediations (parameterized queries, Argon2/bcrypt hashing, rate-limiting).
assertions: Identifies potential injection vulnerabilities and enforces parameterized queries or ORM safe bindings
Mandates secure cryptographic password hashing algorithms (e.g. Argon2, bcrypt) instead of MD5/SHA-1
Recommends rate-limiting or anti-abuse protection against brute-force attacks
Validates input sanitization and boundary checks

evals.prompt: Configure an automated pre-commit and CI pipeline secret scanning workflow to prevent hardcoded credentials.
evals.expected_output: Configuration files for Gitleaks or Trufflehog in pre-commit and CI pipelines with strict exit code on findings.
assertions: Configures secret scanning tool (e.g. gitleaks or trufflehog)
Integrates check into git pre-commit hooks and CI pipeline
Blocks commit or fails build on detection of high-confidence secrets
Documents using environment variables or a Secret Manager instead of hardcoding credentials
